tu1-s01.materials: Ruler or tape per student or pair; rigid object; removable tape; paper and pencils. No fieldhouse access or caliper required.
timing55: Introduce replacement-part problem; students answer first question.
Compare readings and model the spread calculation.
Sketch, hand off, and add missing information.
Individual exit ticket in app or on paper.
tu1-s01.timing110: Use the 55-minute sequence through the sketch. Then 43–55 complete the first explanation; 55–75 repeat with a second tool or observer while holding endpoints constant; 75–90 compare changes in spread; 90–100 revise the drawing; 100–110 write the final exit. Include transitions within these times.
tu1-s01.key: Opening: choice 2. Range check: choice 1. Practice highest 15 11/16, lowest 15 9/16, spread 1/8 in. A fair test changes one factor: for example the observer reads the same tool at the same endpoints directly above and then at an angle. Do not promise a particular result. A systematic offset may remain even with zero spread.
tu1-s01.rating: Rate tr.u1.repeat: 1 = cannot yet identify endpoints/high-low or proposes an unrelated check; 2 = gives a usable spread or plausible cause but needs help with units/control/evidence; 3 = accurate spread with units plus a plausible cause and a controlled check with a predicted discriminating result. Rate sketch separately only from the individual artifact. Use no evidence/not observed rather than inventing a low skill score for absent students.
tu1-s01.fallback: No tool: use the clearly labelled practice readings for reasoning and the drawing task. Do not record instrument-use mastery from supplied data. No internet: paper packet contains the same prompts and scoring criteria.

tu1-s02.materials: Rulers/tapes, paper, pencils; enlarged reference for 1/32 if tools lack those marks.
timing55: Count spaces and identify the smallest division.
Model whole inch plus fraction; first checkpoint.
Partner reading rounds with role changes.
Model nonzero starting point and practice.
tu1-s02.rating: Observe actual placement and reading. 3 = correct denominator, whole part and unit independently, including a nonzero start; 2 = correct with a cue or an isolated error; 1 = needs modelling to identify divisions. Keep written reasoning and watched skill distinct.

tu1-s03.materials: Sliding-hook tape, ruler or verified rigid reference, paper. Caliper optional. No tool alteration.
timing55: Model outside dimensions and inconsistent chain.
tu1-s03.timing110: Add 20 minutes of instrument stations, 20 minutes of repeated comparisons and 15 minutes of drawing revision before the exit.
tu1-s03.key: Checkpoint 3. Inconsistent drawing totals 4 1/4 in, exceeding overall by 1/4 in. Exit: reference accuracy, setup, zero/alignment, inside-versus-outside contact or observer reading could explain disagreement. Repeating a result does not establish the cause.
tu1-s03.rating: 3 = describes reference and setup checks and distinguishes intended movement from damage; 2 = one usable check with partial explanation; 1 = diagnoses from hook movement alone. Dimensioning target rated separately from drawing.

tu1-s04.materials: At least two instruments and a reference checked by the teacher. If only one tool exists, use supplied Tool A/B/C data for reasoning and observe the one tool in a rotating station.
tu1-s04.key: Checkpoint 1. Tool B offset +1/8 in. Consistency is repeatability, not proof of accuracy. Check zero, alignment, reference validity and another known length. Do not assume subtracting 1/8 fixes every reading without testing.
tu1-s04.rating: 3 = records expected/observed values and offset, checks zero/reference, and judges suitability with evidence; 2 = carries out a check with help or incomplete interpretation; 1 = trusts repeated agreement without a reference check.

tu1-s05.materials: Tape/rule, object, caliper and feeler gauge if available. Use tool specifications as provided data if an instrument is absent.
tu1-s05.timing110: Add instrument stations and a revised dimensioned drawing with stated measurement limitations; keep the last 15 minutes for individual exit and self-assessment.
tu1-s05.key: Checkpoint 2. A verified tape/rule may suit the rough layout when its performance supports the tolerance. For the fine gap, a checked suitable feeler gauge or appropriate precision instrument with adequate resolution; do not claim suitability from the instrument name alone. Identical readings show consistency at the observed resolution, not guaranteed accuracy.
tu1-s05.rating: 3 = links instrument resolution and verified performance to each task and distinguishes repeatability from accuracy; 2 = suitable choices with incomplete verification/limits; 1 = chooses by familiarity without considering tolerance.
